assumptions.comparison_mass_basis: Explicit caller-supplied mass sensitivity; not a reconciled installed candidate
assumptions.cost_scope: Stator-only unquoted1250USD/direction-m sensitivity; not station/route CAPEX. Copper mass counted from retained5m winding; cooling/converters/rails/civil/access/fleet not priced.
assumptions.force_scope: Conditional40C fixed-field1349A force is extended below20m/s with unchanged field/current. This speed/position/shared-group domain has not been validated.
assumptions.formations: Repeated54.469347t AW3 car sensitivity only. Longer platform/zone/occupancy counted; no8/10/12car structural/dynamics/vehicle acceptance or whole-train harmonic sharing inherited.
assumptions.progressive_release: Possible separate research only after independent braking/integrity/detectors and distributed protection qualification; no pipeline capacity credit here.
assumptions.protection: Exclusive whole-leg+receiving berth reserved until the complete counted formation tail clears winding end plus75m, then5s allowance. Position time is a lower bound, never detector proof.
assumptions.thermal_scope: Finite5m groups with sampled ideal uniform currents. Copper-only R(T) no-cooling fixture and necessary mean heat-rejection target; no actual thermal equilibrium or cooling hardware mass/cost.
assumptions.topology: One combined launch/receiving zone per station/direction, no midpoint boosters in selected station-only comparisons; no mainline switching

comparison_mass_support_binding.scope: Exact counted support proposal material lower bound only. The declared guide-field/airgap-MMF bound remains optimistic; steel MMF/leakage, bodycarrier, protection, controls and full installed interfaces remain open.

grade_necessary_force_screen.scope: Existing grade sensitivity remains unchanged. Necessary force arithmetic only; actual graded trajectories remain unexecuted. A lower grade would be an explicit product/site constraint, not acceptance of the retained5% case.
